import pandas as pd

def main():
    # List all source file paths
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_8/test_0.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_8/test_1.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_8/test_2.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_8/test_3.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_8/test_4.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_8/test_5.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_8/test_6.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_8/test_7.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_8/test_8.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_8/test_9.csv"
    ]

    # Columns and their target types according to target schema
    target_columns = {
        'admit': int,
        'gre': int,
        'gpa': float,
        'prestige': int
    }

    # Read all source files, convert columns to target types, and concatenate
    dfs = []
    for file_path in source_files:
        df = pd.read_csv(file_path)
        # Ensure columns exist and convert types
        for col, col_type in target_columns.items():
            if col in df.columns:
                df[col] = df[col].astype(col_type)
            else:
                raise ValueError(f"Column '{col}' missing in source file {file_path}")
        dfs.append(df[target_columns.keys()])

    # Concatenate all dataframes vertically (union)
    target_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

    # Optional: If needed, remove duplicates (not specified, so we keep all)
    # target_df = target_df.drop_duplicates()

    # Write the combined dataframe to the target CSV file
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_8/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    target_df.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
